## Summary

**Production fixes:**
- [remote_control/supervisor.py:200](remote_control/supervisor.py:200) — `main()` now parses argv: `--help`/`-h`/`help` → print usage + exit 0; unknown args → exit 2; empty argv → run supervisor (the prior behavior, but only when argv is actually empty).
- [remote_control/config.py:25](remote_control/config.py:25) — new `CLAUDE_BIN = str(Path.home() / ".local/bin/claude")` constant; both `SupervisorConfig.from_env` (:65) and `ManagerConfig.from_env` (:255) now use it instead of the hardcoded `/Users/user/.local/bin/claude` that would crash-loop on any other account.

**New regression tests:**
- [tests/test_supervisor_decisions.py](tests/test_supervisor_decisions.py) — `SupervisorMainArgvTest` (4 cases): help flags don't run the supervisor; unknown args error out; `--help --bogus` is an error not help; empty argv still runs.
- [tests/test_config.py](tests/test_config.py) — `test_claude_bin_default_is_per_user` (regression: no `/Users/user/` in default) + `test_claude_bin_env_override`. Updated existing `test_defaults`.

**Cleanup:** Reverted the ad-hoc `tick: wanted=... running=... deact=...` debug logging from supervisor.py (it served its purpose; not needed for the permanent fix).

**Result:** Both bugs that caused tonight's flap are now fixed with passing tests. The rogue supervisor that was running for 9h44m is dead; the launchd-managed one is holding all 6 children stably. The supervisor on mini is still running the pre-fix code in memory — when convenient, `launchctl kickstart -k gui/$UID/com.claudio1.claude-remote-control` will pick up the fixes (and confirm `python -m remote_control supervisor --help` now prints usage instead of running).
I still see tons of envs on claude

Confirmed: **no new phantoms are being added** (zero supervisor activity since 21:54:40, ~7 min ago; only one supervisor; all 6 children stable for 7+ min). What you're still seeing in the picker is the leftover registrations from the 9-hour cross-supervisor fight — they haven't expired yet.

**The bad news:** there's no CLI to deregister them. `claude remote-control --help` has no `--deregister` flag, and the codebase only knows the `/v1/code/sessions` endpoint — there's no client for `/v1/code/environment/*` (which is what the picker entries are).
